title: Genetics and Intelligence
summary: Steve Hsu's 2011 Google Tech Talk reviews psychometric measurement of intelligence and the heritability of adult IQ, then discusses genome-wide association studies seeking the genes behind cognitive ability.
why: Pointed to as a well-cited hour on IQ and genetics whenever intelligence and heritability come up.

quote.text: You can also choose to spend an hour on this talk by Stephen Hsu who does research on IQ and genetics
